title: Origins of structural and electronic transitions in disordered silicon
summary: ML potentials enabled 100,000-atom simulations revealing a three-step transformation of amorphous silicon under pressure, predicting structure, stability and electronic properties.
ai_technology: Atomistic machine-learning interatomic potential trained on quantum-mechanical data

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Simulation results compared to quantum-mechanical data; experimental confirmation not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Learned potential made large-scale simulations feasible.
